sources.title: nm-testing/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-block · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was obtained by quantizing the weights and activations of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B to FP8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%.
